model.implementation: transformers.AutoModelForSequenceClassification; raw logits, no sigmoid or 0–4 mapping

runtime.truncation_policy: No silent truncation: measure untruncated token length before scoring and fail if any exceeds 8192.
runtime.schedule: Run only after Qwen development batch completes; keep existing Qwen server resident.

judge_run.timing_scope: Total includes input loading, tokenization, model loading and inference; excludes imports, model download and SSH file transfers. Inference includes GPU work and incremental output serialization.

stage1_judge.judged_calls_definition: top-K query/passage judgments used; includes cache hits, not subprocess batches

E0_judge.judged_calls_definition: top-K query/passage judgments used; includes cache hits, not subprocess batches
